```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(RcppRoll)
```

```{r}
final_data <- read_csv("../data/final_data.csv")
```
Feature engineering
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(RcppRoll)
library(purrr)

# Define U.S. federal holidays for 2017
holidays_2017 <- ymd(c(
  "2017-01-02", "2017-01-16", "2017-02-20", "2017-05-29",
  "2017-07-04", "2017-09-04", "2017-10-09", "2017-11-10",
  "2017-11-23", "2017-12-25"
))

# Define the features to apply lags and rolling averages to
lag_roll_features <- c(
  "Thermostat_Temperature", "Humidity", "T_out", "RH_out", "DHI", "DNI",
  "GHI", "sin_wind_dir", "cos_wind_dir", "Wind_Speed"
)

# Define the time steps in hours for the features (converted to 5-min increments)
time_steps <- c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 4, 8, 12, 24)
n_rows <- time_steps * 12

# Function to create lagged features
create_lag_features <- function(data, feature, n_rows) {
  lag_name <- paste0(feature, "_lag_", n_rows / 12, "h")
  data %>%
    mutate(!!lag_name := lag(!!sym(feature), n = n_rows))
}

# Function to create rolling average features
create_roll_features <- function(data, feature, n_rows) {
  roll_name <- paste0(feature, "_rollavg_", n_rows / 12, "h")
  data %>%
    mutate(!!roll_name := RcppRoll::roll_mean(!!sym(feature), n = n_rows, align = "right", na.rm = TRUE, fill = NA))
}

# Start with your initial data frame and time-based features
engineered_data <- final_data %>%
  select(-Identifier, -State, -T_ctrl, -starts_with("auxHeat"), -starts_with("comp"), -fan, - starts_with("Remote")) %>%
  arrange(DateTime) %>%
  mutate(
    hour = hour(DateTime),
    day_of_week = wday(DateTime, label = TRUE),
    is_weekend = factor(case_when(day_of_week %in% c("Sat", "Sun") ~ TRUE, .default = FALSE)),
    is_holiday = factor(as.Date(DateTime) %in% holidays_2017),
    season = case_when(
      DateTime > ymd("2017-03-20") & DateTime <= ymd("2017-06-20") ~ "Spring",
      DateTime > ymd("2017-06-20") & DateTime <= ymd("2017-09-22") ~ "Summer",
      DateTime > ymd("2017-09-22") & DateTime <= ymd("2017-12-21") ~ "Autumn",
      TRUE ~ "Winter"
    ),
    HVAC_off = case_when(
      HvacMode == "off" ~ TRUE,
      Thermostat_Temperature > T_stp_heat + 2 & Thermostat_Temperature < T_stp_cool - 2 ~ TRUE,
      .default = FALSE
    )
  )

# Loop to create all lag and rolling average features
for (feature in lag_roll_features) {
  for (n_val in n_rows) {
    engineered_data <- create_lag_features(engineered_data, feature, n_val)
    engineered_data <- create_roll_features(engineered_data, feature, n_val)
  }
}

# View the new column names
glimpse(engineered_data)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Assuming 'engineered_data' is your data frame from the previous step,
# and it already has the 'HVAC_off' column.

engineered_data_with_duration <- engineered_data %>%
  # Create a unique ID for each continuous run of 'HVAC_off'
  group_by(run_id = cumsum(!HVAC_off)) %>%
  # Calculate the duration in minutes for each row within the group
  mutate(HVAC_off_duration_min = if_else(
    HVAC_off,
    (row_number() - 1) * 5,
    0
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Remove the temporary grouping variable
  select(-run_id)
```

```{r}
final_engineered_data <- engineered_data_with_duration
```

```{r}
write_csv(final_engineered_data, "../data/final_engineered_data.csv")
```
